newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - SECHABA REMAINS ACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - SECHABA REMAINS ACTIVE.

text.p: Brewery holding company Sechaba
continued to be the most active counter on the Botswana Stock
Exchange (BSE) last week with local demand satisfied by foreign
sales.
However, the counter traded down 10 thebe to close at 240
thebe after earlier trades at 245 thebe.
No stocks traded up last week.
Trading unchanged were security group Inco, clothing chain
Pep, milling company and food wholesaler Sefalana, and Standard
Chartered.
Investment company Kgolo ya Sechaba, last traded at 145
thebe, was suspended on Wednesday following the premature
release of the announcment of its voluntary unwinding. No
earlier trades in the counter were recorded during the week.
The remaining counters were untraded.
Volume and value were marginally up over the week, with
151,200 shares worth 396,950 pula traded compared with the
149,775 shares valued at 393,983 pula traded in the previous
week.
